title: The Spec Plate
briefing: Somebody 'accidentally' changed the RAM spec sheet last night, and we built a whole batch of 31 GB sticks. Never again! The standard spec is being stamped onto a steel plate: a tuple, which can never be changed. Use it to check how many sticks in the batch match.
hints: A tuple uses round brackets: STANDARD = (32, 5600). Unpacking gives each value its own variable in one line: capacity, speed = STANDARD.
Tuples have two methods: specs.count(STANDARD) counts matches and specs.index(STANDARD) finds the first match. To 'change' a tuple you build a new one.
STANDARD = (32, 5600), capacity, speed = STANDARD, matching = specs.count(STANDARD), first_match = specs.index(STANDARD), fast_spec = (capacity, 6400)
bonus: Try STANDARD[0] = 64 in a Try it box. Read the error: that's Python protecting your tuple!
